scope: Prospective diagnostic of ordered-default off-path cost; no new adoption gate or unique causal attribution
primary: graph1/timer-unset old,new,new,old; three quartets for each default/det x pick0/1 =48 legs
graph1_instrumented: timer1 old,new,new,old; one quartet per mode x pick =16 separate diagnostic legs
graph0_instrumentation_control: pick0 only; timer0,timer1,timer1,timer0 within each old/new x mode =16 separate diagnostic legs
timer0_semantics: EMBER_DECODE_TIMING absent, not string0 (presence enables it)
bounds: No performance threshold; preserve all raw outcomes, IDs/token-path comparability and all paired ratios/ranges. Instrumented or graph0 arms cannot be pooled into primary graph1 estimates.
primary_estimator: unchanged frozen wall-minus-first-token throughput with warm-pass and no-spec contracts
telemetry: one common1Hz nvidia-smi clock/power/temperature/utilization process for all legs; overhead part of this diagnostic, not assumed zero
phase_limit: EMBER_DECODE_TIMING synchronizes phase boundaries and changes the workload. Graph0 phases are synchronized wall time, not pure kernel event time; graph1 host/control timing may not expose captured kernel subphases.

historical_observations.on: similar/slightly lower; relative selector gate PASS is not absolute acceleration

failure_policy: one scientific attempt; preserve incomplete/negative data, no retry-for-pass, adaptive subset, threshold change, atomic reenable, default selector change or E9 edits
